name: LeaveSeqr
description: Ambient leaf physics sequencer: leaves fall through air, float on water, sink to mud — three generative tracks with triop bass echoes.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Sandman
description: A living portrait: falling sand, leaves and water that become music. Portrait orientation, physics simulation, step sequencer.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Serpentine Dev
description: Snake sequencer game — development version with all latest features
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Serpentine minified
description: Snake sequencer game — minified copy of the development version, for uploading to the device
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Color Fallback Demo
description: Made to test the color_fallback() function, shows how you can use it to make a monochrome version of your script that still looks good on a monochrome grid, more info in the github folder uf2s
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Monochrome Fallback
description: Brightness slider demo —  my first monochrome fallback example, color_fallback_demo is a better example of this but I wanted to keep this one around for testing purposes
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Color Workaround Demo
description: Shows how grid_led_rgb() overrides keep cyan accurate at low brightness, where tinted grid_led() turns orange on NeoTrellis.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Text Runner
description: Renders a 3x5 pixel font and scrolls text. Top-row buttons pick slow, medium or fast scrolling, or chunk mode.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Multi-Screen Test
description: Demo for multiple-screen emulation and NeoTrellis color handling across separate screen buffers.
author: Gemini / jonwtr

name: Grid Color Test
description: Test script for NeoTrellis / Monome color compatibility.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Color Threshold Test
description: Finds the brightness levels where NeoTrellis LEDs start rendering tinted colors incorrectly, next to grid_led_rgb() references.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Power Test
description: Tests the Power Limiter and grid_color_intensity() function, was made to test brownout of the leds. Needs a color grid.
author: jonwaterschoot

name: Script template
description: Starting point for your own script. The Guide tab walks you through it; LLM_INSTRUCTIONS.md is the version to give to an LLM.
author: jonwaterschoot
